original_title: Introducing Azaindole Thianthrenium Salt: An Electrophilic Coupling Partner for Cross-Coupling Reaction
title: A thianthrenium handle for azaindole C3
blurb: Thianthrenation installs a leaving group right at C3 of azaindoles, and that salt turns out to be a general electrophile: Suzuki, Heck, Sonogashira, Hiyama, Barluenga-Valdes, all run off the same intermediate. Site-selective access to azaindole derivatives that are normally a pain to make cleanly.

original_title: Ni–Ir Interaction Enables a Dark Reactive State in Nickel Catalysis
title: Watching what a Ni-Ir photoredox catalyst is actually doing mid-cycle
blurb: Ni-Ir metallophotoredox catalysis works better than plain nickel at C-C and C-heteroatom coupling, but nobody could pin down why because untangling two metal centers spectroscopically is hard. Element-specific ultrafast probes of both metals here turn up a dark reactive state that only shows up from direct Ni-Ir interaction, which is presumably what's rescuing that sluggish Ni(II) reductive elimination.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: A Novel Protein Corona-Based Secretome Profiling Assisting Cell Multiomics Analysis
title: Getting the secretome into the multiomics stack
blurb: Multiomics keeps leaving the secretome out because enrichment methods are noisy, blind to low-abundance proteins, and tend to perturb the cells you're profiling. This is a protein corona-based profiling approach built to fold secretome data into a multiomics workflow instead of treating it as an afterthought.

original_title: DAPhen vs BLPhen: Transposition of Coordination Centers Redirects the Metal Binding Affinity
title: Move the lactam ring, and the ligand stops liking lanthanides
blurb: A set of bis-lactam phenanthroline ligands with 5- to 7-membered rings, characterized by 2D NMR and X-ray, then titrated against lanthanide trinitrates and Al/Zn/Pb perchlorates. With the f-elements the metal complex just sits in equilibrium with free ligand, weak binding. With d-metals it cleanly locks into an L2M complex. So where the coordinating groups sit decides whether you get a lanthanide binder or a transition-metal one.

original_title: An Instrumental Optimization of a Label-Free Proteomic Method for Trace Protein Input
title: More protein IDs from less sample, same Orbitrap you already own
blurb: No new hardware here, just a systematic tuning of a standard Orbitrap/UHPLC setup for trace-input samples like tens of cells or a single tissue region. Got over 5600 proteins identified from 5 ng of peptide, which is the kind of gain you'd normally expect to pay for with specialized instrumentation.

original_title: Chiral Macrocyclic Borane-Catalyzed Asymmetric Hydrogenation of 2-Substituted Quinolines
title: A metal-free borane hydrogenates quinolines, mostly
blurb: Chiral macrocyclic boranes outperform their acyclic versions on both activity and ee for hydrogenating 2-alkylquinolines to tetrahydroquinolines, no metal catalyst involved, 87-98% yield and up to 96% ee. The macrocycle is clearly doing the work here. Swap in 2-phenylquinoline and the stereoselectivity drops to just moderate, so the alkyl substrates are where this method actually earns its keep.

original_title: Direct low-energy gamma-ray measurement of <sup>129</sup>I in radioactive waste using LEGe spectrometry and evaluation of the minimum detectable activity
title: Pinning down I-129 in nuclear waste by its faint gamma line
blurb: A LEGe spectrometer setup for direct low-energy gamma measurement of I-129 in radioactive waste, with the minimum detectable activity worked out. Not flashy, but that MDA number is exactly what waste characterization protocols actually run on.

original_title: Technical Note: A Practical and Scalable Method for the Preparation of 3-Acylindole Scaffold Using N , N -Dimethylamides via the Vilsmeier–Haack Reaction
title: Vilsmeier-Haack acylation that skips the column
blurb: A Vilsmeier-Haack protocol using plain N,N-dialkylamides and POCl3 to acylate 2-arylindoles regioselectively at C3, across a wide range of substrates and acylating agents, in high yield with no chromatography needed. The reagents are boring on purpose; the no-column workup is the actual pitch for anyone who's hand-purified an indole library.

original_title: Multicomplex Integrative Structural Modeling of a Human Histone Deacetylase Interactome.
title: Mapping how HDAC complexes actually fit together
blurb: Integrative structural modeling applied across multiple complexes to build out the human histone deacetylase interactome, rather than solving each complex in isolation. HDACs mostly work as obligate multi-subunit machines, so a structural picture that spans complexes is the more honest way to look at them.

original_title: Catalytic Hydroacylation of Alkynes with Aldehydes by a Cp′Mo Catalyst
title: Hydroacylating alkynes without paying the noble-metal tax
blurb: First intermolecular hydroacylation of alkynes run on a non-noble molybdenum catalyst, using a tetramethylcyclopentadienyl ligand to keep the usual decarbonylation side reaction from eating the yield. Up to 97% with excellent E/Z selectivity and broad functional group tolerance, a cheap-metal stand-in for a reaction that's normally rhodium or ruthenium territory.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Activity-Based Ubiquitin-α-amidomethyl Acrylate Probe for Profiling of Ubiquitinating Enzymes and Deubiquitinases.
title: One probe for both ubiquitin writers and erasers
blurb: An activity-based probe, ubiquitin fitted with an α-amidomethyl acrylate warhead, built to react with ubiquitinating enzymes and deubiquitinases alike so both sides of the mark can be profiled in one experiment.

original_title: Enantioselective Decarboxylative Synthesis of Chiral α-Silylamines and α-Germylamines
title: Chiral amines get a silicon and germanium option
blurb: A nickel-catalyzed decarboxylative coupling turns amino acid or peptide-derived redox-active esters plus silylzinc or germylzinc reagents into chiral α-silylamines and α-germylamines, enantioselectively. Silicon and germanium scaffolds have been sitting underused in med chem for lack of a general stereocontrolled route, so this is mostly about finally having the method rather than the specific molecules.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Low-Pressure Hydrogenation of Enoates and Carbonyl Compounds with a Bifunctional Copper(I)/NHC Catalyst
title: Copper hydride hydrogenation without the brutal pressure
blurb: Cu(I) hydride catalysis usually needs strongly basic conditions and high H2 pressure to touch enoates and carbonyls. This bifunctional NHC copper catalyst, built around a 2-iminopyridine unit, runs the same hydrogenations at low pressure under standard conditions. Practical rather than flashy, but that's the point.

original_title: K3Sr3Li2Ga4B6O20F: A Sr2Be2B2O7-Type Ultraviolet Nonlinear Optical Crystal
title: A beryllium-free stand-in for SBBO
blurb: K3Sr3Li2Ga4B6O20F swaps the toxic Be out of the Sr2Be2B2O7-type UV nonlinear optical crystal by co-substituting Sr2+/Be2+ with K+/Sr2+ and Li+/Ga3+. Same layered borate framework, none of the beryllium handling headaches, if it actually matches SBBO's optical performance and not just its structure.

original_title: Fluorescent Nanodiamond-Based Delivery Systems for Mitochondrial Targeting of Bioactive Peptides.
title: Nanodiamonds as a mitochondria-targeted peptide delivery
blurb: A fluorescent nanodiamond platform engineered to carry bioactive peptides specifically into mitochondria, trading on the particles' native fluorescence for tracking as they go.

original_title: Persilylated and Related Silyl Anion‐Induced Synthesis of Group 3–10 Metal–Silyl Complexes
title: Bulky silyl anions as the toolkit for metal-silyl bonds
blurb: A review of persilylated and related silyl anions across group 3-10 chemistry: their strong sigma-donation and steric bulk stabilize otherwise unreachable low-coordinate metal centers, mostly via salt metathesis. Useful as a reference for anyone hunting unusual metal-silicon bonding, less a result than a map of one.

original_title: DNA Sequence-Programmed Protein Coronas Determine Intracellular Fate and Proteostatic Stress of Carbon Nanotubes
title: The DNA wrapping on a nanotube decides where it ends up in the cell
blurb: Single-walled carbon nanotubes pick up a protein corona once they hit biological fluid, and this shows the corona's identity, set by the DNA sequence wrapping the tube, actually determines intracellular fate and how much proteostatic stress the cell takes on. That corona effect usually gets discussed for sensing and drug delivery performance, not for what happens to the nanotube once it's inside the cell.

original_title: Site-Resolved Prediction of Mayr Nucleophilicity with Reactivity-Pretrained Graph Neural Networks
title: A GNN that points at which atom is the nucleophile
blurb: Most ML models score Mayr nucleophilicity for a whole molecule and leave you to guess where the reaction actually happens. PPGNS is a reactivity-pretrained graph neural network, trained on curated reaction-site annotations plus GFN1-xTB features, that predicts nucleophilicity site by site instead.

original_title: Helical Unwinding Governs Divergent Kinetics in the Reductive Defluorination of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances
title: PFAS degradation rates trace back to backbone geometry, not just bond strength
blurb: C-F bond strength alone doesn't explain why some PFAS degrade faster than others under reduction. Quantum chemical calculations here pin the missing variable on the perfluorocarbon backbone's ability to unwind from its native helical shape, folding that into the Marcus and Savéant models with the hydrated electron as the reference reductant.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Metal-Acid Balance Enables Earth-Abundant Metal Upcycling of Polyolefins to Jet Fuel
title: Cheap nickel instead of noble metal for turning plastic into jet fuel
blurb: Hydrocracking polyolefin waste into fuel usually leans on bifunctional metal-acid catalysts built from noble metals. Here atomically dispersed Ni and sulfate sites on a zirconia support let the metal and acid functions be tuned independently, balancing (de)hydrogenation against C-C cleavage well enough to get jet fuel out of an earth-abundant metal instead.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Elucidating Photo‐Kinetic Control in Photothermal Reverse Water‐Gas Shift Reaction
title: Light does more than heat things up in this RWGS catalyst
blurb: Photothermal catalysis usually gets treated as just localized heating plus some charge carriers, but here illumination actually shifts the rate-determining step in the reverse water-gas shift reaction over In-doped MoO2. Direct kinetic evidence for something people mostly hand-waved before.

original_title: Transformative Masked Ortho‐Quinone Chemistry: From Direct Guaiacol Activation to Lignin‐Based Adhesives
title: A quinone trick for turning lignin into glue
blurb: PIDA oxidizes guaiacol, the biophenolic motif sitting all over softwood lignin, into masked ortho-quinones in minutes at room temperature. Those react with thiols to build TGC polymers, aimed at adhesives made from a waste stream instead of petroleum.

original_title: Hexacoordinate Actinide(IV) Compounds: Benchmark Complexes for Magnetism and Electronic Structure Analysis
title: Six-coordinate U, Np, Pu chlorides, catalogued for the magnetism crowd
blurb: A matched series of AnCl4(L)2 complexes across uranium, neptunium and plutonium, same octahedral geometry, same trans ligand arrangement, built as reference points for actinide magnetism and electronic structure work. The Np one distorts when THF isn't around to hydrogen-bond the ligand, which is the kind of detail this whole exercise exists to catch.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Structure-Based Model for Solvatochromism: Charge Transfer Driven by Ligand–Solvent Interactions
title: Predicting solvatochromism from structure instead of just fitting the spectrum
blurb: A PCM-DFT/TD-DFT pipeline that ties solvent-driven structural changes in Mo-dithiolene complexes directly to shifts in their charge-transfer bands, validated against both the reduced and oxidized dithiolene forms. It's a modeling paper, so it earns its keep only if it predicts systems nobody's measured yet.

original_title: Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer-Driven Fragmentation and Functionalization Strategies for Carbohydrate Diversification
title: One glycosyl alcohol, three different ways to break it apart
blurb: A PCET strategy activates plain glycosyl alcohols and routes them into fragmentative hydrogenation, radical conjugate addition, or nickel/photoredox cross-coupling depending on what you need. A genuinely unified way to get C-H, C-C sp3-sp3, and C-C sp3-sp2 bonds out of sugar donors that are easy to make in the first place.

original_title: Designing Multilayered Photoanodes for Broad‐Scope Thiol Trifluoromethylation
title: A layered photoanode built to keep radical trifluoromethylation from going sloppy
blurb: Radical thiol trifluoromethylations usually lose scope because the radical outruns the substrate's own reactivity. Stacking Co2P-loaded carbon nitride dots onto WO3 films fixes that mismatch enough to hit 95% conversion on the model thiophenol substrate under 450 nm light.

original_title: Million-Turnover Photocatalysis Enabled by Far-Red-Light-Responsive Gold Nanoclusters
title: A gold nanocluster that runs a million photocatalytic cycles on far-red light
blurb: Blue-light photosensitizers don't penetrate far, which is a real problem past lab scale. This Au27 nanocluster, built from an icosahedral Au13 core plus a tetrahedral Au4 cap, generates singlet oxygen efficiently under far-red light instead, and does it enough times to earn the million-turnover in the title.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Regioselective Palladium-Catalyzed Direct C3–H Arylation of Triazolopyridazines with Aryl Thianthrenium Salts
title: Arylating triazolopyridazines at C3 with thianthrenium salts instead of aryl halides
blurb: A palladium-catalyzed C-H arylation that swaps the usual aryl halide coupling partner for aryl thianthrenium salts, landing regioselectively at C3 under mild conditions with a scope broad enough to run gram-scale. Mechanistic work including radical-trapping backs up how it's actually working, not just that it works.

original_title: Competition-Derived Relative Reactivity and 3D Electronic-State Analysis of Site- and Facial Selectivity in NaBH4/MeOH Ketone Reductions
title: Ranking 89 ketones by how fast NaBH4 actually reduces them
blurb: Yields lie because side reactions and workup get in the way, so this one runs head-to-head competition experiments instead, turning 89 ketone faces into a single activation-energy scale for NaBH4/MeOH reduction. Ties the numbers back to electronics and sterics with transition-state calculations, which makes it a reference table more than another reduction paper.

original_title: Photochemical Reaction of Vinyldiazo Esters and Azides: Synthesis of β-Oxodiazo Compounds
title: Turning vinyldiazo esters into a diazo class nobody's really touched
blurb: Photolysis of vinyldiazo esters generates a transient cyclopropene-carboxylate, which grabs TMSN3 in a 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition and kicks back out to give beta-diazoimines, and hydrolysis of those opens up beta-diazoaldehydes and beta-diazoketones. Both the carbonyl and diazo ends get used for further chemistry, which is the point of making an underexplored compound class in the first place.

original_title: Intramolecular EDA Complex-Induced Dearomatization/Spirocyclization of Indolyl Propiolamides
title: Visible light dearomatizes indoles without a photocatalyst
blurb: An EDA complex between the indolyl propiolamide substrates handles the electron transfer itself, so the radical dearomatization/spirocyclization to 3,3-spiroindolenines runs on just visible light, no photocatalyst added. Good yields, decent functional group tolerance, and they bothered to scale it up.

original_title: Heterogeneous Photocatalytic Oxidation of Toluene to Benzaldehyde over Nickel Coordinated Metatungstate, [Ni(dmbpy)3]2H2[H2W12O40]
title: A nickel-doped polytungstate turns toluene into benzaldehyde on visible light alone
blurb: [Ni(dmbpy)3]2H2[H2W12O40], built from an electron-sponge Keggin polyoxoanion, activates the C(sp3)-H bond of toluene under >420 nm light with no added photosensitizer. The pitch is skipping the extra sensitizer chemistry these POM photocatalysts usually need.

original_title: Reconciling Activity and Selectivity in Photocatalytic HMF Oxidation over PtCo/g-C3N4 via d-Band Center Engineering
title: Tuning a Pt catalyst's d-band to stop overoxidizing HMF
blurb: PtCo/g-C3N4 addresses the usual activity-selectivity trade-off in photocatalytic HMF-to-DFF oxidation by shifting the Pt d-band center 0.33 eV via Co alloying, slowing intermediate desorption enough to stop the reaction running past DFF. A knob-turning paper, but the knob is well characterized.

original_title: Highly Stereoselective Synthesis of trans -5-Phosphorylthiazoline-4-amines via [1 + 4] Annulation of α-Phosphoryl Diazoalkanes and Thioacylamidines
title: A [1+4] route to trans-phosphorylthiazoline-4-amines
blurb: α-Phosphoryl diazoalkanes generate a carbene in situ and get trapped by thioacylamidines in a tandem [1+4] annulation, delivering the trans-configured thiazoline products in good to excellent yield across a wide substrate scope. Straightforward atom-economical heterocycle building, nothing fancier than that.

original_title: Asymmetric Synthesis of Axially Chiral Spiro Aziridines and Spiro Thiazolidinethiones from Sulfonyl Bicyclobutanes
title: Bicyclobutanes ring-open into spiro aziridines with two kinds of chirality at once
blurb: Cs2CO3-mediated ring opening of sulfonyl bicyclobutanes bearing chiral sulfinamides builds 1-aza-spiro[2,3]hexanes and spiro thiazolidinethiones with both axial and point chirality set in one step. No expensive multimetal catalysis needed, which is the actual selling point.

original_title: Asymmetric Synthesis of Atropisomers Featuring an Aza‐Axis via N ‐Heterocyclic Carbene Catalysis
title: What NHC catalysis has done for aza-axis atropisomers
blurb: A review tracking catalytic asymmetric construction of aza-axial chirality across C-N, N-N, C-O, and C-B axes, a field that sat mostly untouched after Taguchi and Curran's early-2000s reports until N-heterocyclic carbene catalysis picked it up. Useful for the state of play, not a new result.

original_title: Selective Synthesis of Cis-1 and Cis-2 Bisaziridino[60]fullerenes in the Presence of Stoichiometric Amounts of Cu(OTf)2
title: Picking cis-1 over cis-2 in bis-aziridinofullerenes with stoichiometric copper
blurb: Reacting C60 with organic azides in chlorobenzene at 100°C with a full equivalent of Cu(OTf)2 pushes the double aziridination to exclusively the cis-1 regioisomer for linear or aromatic azides. A blunt but apparently reliable way to control fullerene bis-adduct symmetry, which has been an annoying problem for a while.

original_title: Improving recombinant protein productivity in CHO cells via multi-omics data integration
title: Mining CHO cell omics data to squeeze more protein out of them
blurb: A look at using multi-omics integration, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and the rest, to get past the limits of tweaking media and cell lines by hand for CHO-based biologic production. The framing is that pathway complexity and cell-to-cell variability have outrun what trial-and-error process optimization can handle alone.

original_title: ALIGNing Learned Representations: Domain-General Models Triangulate Physicochemical Interactions in Analytical Separations
title: Foundation models for chemistry keep failing to generalize, this one tries triangulation instead
blurb: The diagnosis: SMILES and graph representations don't line up well with what's actually measured in analytical separations, so most chemistry foundation models don't transfer past their training set. The fix is pretraining across multiple measurement contexts at once, forcing the representation to stay physically coherent across all of them instead of overfitting to one dataset.

original_title: One-Pot Reaction of α-Diazo Phosphonates via Iodine-Catalyzed Cascade Radical Aerobic Oxidation and C–P Bond Cleavage
title: Diazophosphonates go to carboxylic acids via an iodine radical relay
blurb: An iodine-catalyzed aerobic cascade turns α-diazophosphonates into aromatic carboxylic acids in one pot, up to 82% yield, via an iodoalkyl radical that grabs O2 then abstracts a hydrogen from the DCM solvent before silica gel finishes the job with C-P cleavage. DFT backs the mechanism, and using the solvent itself as the H-donor is a nice touch.

original_title: From Deposition Stress to Surface Reactivity: Strain-Dependent Hydrogen Evolution on Sputtered Platinum Thin Films
title: Sputtering pressure is a hidden knob on platinum's hydrogen evolution
blurb: Magnetron-sputtered Pt films built at different sputter pressures come out with different residual strain and microstructure, and that strain state tracks with HER activity, backed up by DFT. The films even shift their (111) texture as deposition conditions change. Nice reminder that a catalyst's activity can hinge on how you deposited it, not just what it's made of.

original_title: Nickel-Catalyzed Regio- and Diastereoselective Ring-Opening Reductive Coupling of Methylenecyclopropanes with Aldehydes
title: A nickel catalyst pries open methylenecyclopropanes for aldehydes
blurb: Ring-opening reductive coupling of methylenecyclopropanes with aldehydes, catalyzed by nickel, gives bishomoallylic alcohols under mild conditions. 37 examples, broad functional group tolerance, and generally high diastereoselectivity, which is the actual hard part when you're cracking a strained ring open with any control at all.

original_title: Covalent Organic Framework Colloids With Core‐Shell Donor/Acceptor Architecture and Ultralong‐Lived Charge‐Separated States
title: Core-shell COF particles that keep their electrons and holes apart
blurb: Donor and acceptor covalent organic frameworks, built isostructurally but with different electronics, get assembled into core-shell colloids. That forms a p-n heterojunction that spatially separates photogenerated electrons and holes while each domain stays crystalline, and the charge-separated state ends up living unusually long. The crystallinity is the part COFs usually struggle to keep once you start engineering in heterojunctions.

original_title: Protein language model-generated enzyme sequences exhibit high stability in molecular dynamics simulations
title: Language-model-designed enzymes hold their shape in simulation
blurb: Finenzyme generates enzyme sequences conditioned on EC number, and this adds an in silico selection step on top that picks out the sequences most likely to preserve or improve function for a given EC category. Those picks then run stable through molecular dynamics simulations. Stable in an MD trajectory isn't the same as active in a test tube, but it's a reasonable filter before anyone bothers making the protein.

original_title: PHYS.Org: Scientists capture first molecular-level images of water reorganization during a reaction crucial for life
title: PHYS.Org: Scientists capture first molecular-level images of water reorganization during a reaction crucial for life
blurb: See also: The publication in Nature Communications

original_title: GSK catches phase 3 fever after mRNA flu vaccine beats standard shots
title: GSK catches phase 3 fever after mRNA flu vaccine beats standard shots

original_title: Endoskeleton-Enhanced Virus-Like Particles (VLPs): Internal Cross-Linking of Physalis Mottle Virus and Stability Tests.
title: A stiffer virus-like particle, cross-linked from the inside
blurb: A protocols chapter for reinforcing Physalis mottle virus-like particles with internal cross-links, then running the stability tests to see whether the reinforced shell actually holds up better. More of a lab how-to than a new finding.

original_title: A 177Lu-Labeled Circular Bivalent Aptamer for PTK7-Targeting Radionuclide Therapy in Ovarian Cancer and Orthotopic Hepatoblastoma
title: An aptamer standing in for the antibody in radionuclide therapy
blurb: A Lu-177-labeled circular bivalent aptamer targeting PTK7, tested against ovarian cancer and orthotopic hepatoblastoma. Cyclizing it into a bivalent loop boosts stability and binding, and the labeled version held up in serum, found PTK7-positive cells specifically, got internalized, and killed cells in a dose-dependent way. Still in vitro, but aptamers are a lot cheaper to make than the antibodies this field usually reaches for.

original_title: Biomaterial and bioorthogonal surface engineering of a modular dextran–lipid nanoplatform for tumorresponsive cytokine delivery
title: A dextran-lipid particle that waits for the tumor before dumping its cytokine
blurb: Azide-tagged dextran gets bioorthogonal surface handles and gets built into hybrid nanoparticles with an ionizable lipidoid, meant to release a pro-inflammatory cytokine only in the tumor microenvironment. The design is modular, but the whole point is dodging the systemic toxicity that usually sinks cytokine therapy before it gets anywhere.

original_title: New lab at ORNL speeds up U-233 cleanup, Ac-225 delivery - American Nuclear Society -- ANS
title: ORNL builds a faster lane for U-233 cleanup and Ac-225 output
blurb: A new lab at Oak Ridge meant to do two things at once, clear out old U-233 stock and speed up Ac-225 output. Good news for anyone tired of hearing that alpha therapy is supply-limited.

original_title: Production and quality control of no-carrier-added 161Tb from enriched 160Gd target material
title: No-carrier-added Tb-161, made from enriched Gd-160
blurb: A production and quality-control writeup for making no-carrier-added Terbium-161 from enriched Gadolinium-160 targets. Unglamorous, but it's the supply-chain step that has to work before Tb-161 shows up in anyone's radioligand.

original_title: Solvatochromism and Click Reactivity of Yellow Tetrazines
title: Why some tetrazines turn yellow instead of the usual pink
blurb: Hydroxypyridyl-tetrazines, the newer click-to-release reagents, show up yellow in methanol and buffer instead of tetrazine's usual pink, and it traces back to the protonation state of a phenolic OH group. That same protonation state changes how fast the Diels-Alder click reaction runs, so the color shift isn't just cosmetic, it's telling you something about the reactivity you're about to get.

original_title: Nickel-Catalyzed cis -Arylation of Unactivated gem -Difluoroalkenes: A Pathway for the Construction of a Fluorinated Amino Acid Molecular Library
title: A nickel catalyst that arylates the fluoroalkenes everyone else leaves alone
blurb: Unactivated gem-difluoroalkenes are normally too inert to touch selectively, but a picolinamide directing group plus a nickel catalyst gets clean cis-arylation on norvaline-derived scaffolds anyway, high yields across a broad substrate scope. The payoff is a fast route into a whole library of nonnatural fluorinated amino acids.

original_title: Effect of Carbon-Chain Length in [(125)I]iodophenyl and [(211)At]astatophenyl Derivatives on Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen-Targeted Radioligands.
title: Chain length is doing the work in these PSMA radioligands
blurb: A comparison of iodophenyl (I-125) and astatophenyl (At-211) derivatives on PSMA-targeted radioligands, varying just the carbon-chain length of the linker. Framing it around chain length alone says that's the variable that matters here.

original_title: Neoadjuvant anti-HER2 antibody-drug conjugate SHR-A1811 in Hormone Receptor-positive, HER2-low Breast Cancer: A Phase 2 Clinical Trial (HELEN-015)
title: Neoadjuvant SHR-A1811 gets its own trial in HR+/HER2-low breast cancer
blurb: HELEN-015 is a single-arm Phase 2 taking the anti-HER2 ADC SHR-A1811, already active in HER2-low advanced breast cancer, and pushing it into the neoadjuvant setting for hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-low disease with high Ki-67. This covers the trial design and eligibility; the efficacy readout is the part worth waiting for.

original_title: Cipla inks exclusive licensing agreement with SBP Group for ADC Rolditamig Deuderuxtecan - Business Standard
title: Cipla picks up rights to SBP Group's ADC
blurb: An exclusive licensing deal between Cipla and SBP Group for the antibody-drug conjugate Rolditamig deduruxtecan. That's the whole announcement, no terms or trial data attached.

original_title: An Inhalable Hybrid Nitric Oxide Nanogenerator for Lung Adenocarcinoma Treatment via Bioorthogonal-Activated Gas-Immunotherapy
title: An inhaled NO generator that only switches on inside the tumor
blurb: A Pt-based prodrug packed into TME-responsive hybrid micelles releases nitric oxide through a bioorthogonal trigger, aiming to break platinum resistance in lung adenocarcinoma by reprogramming the tumor microenvironment rather than just piling on more cisplatin. Delivered by inhalation, which at least keeps the dose out of general circulation if it works as advertised.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Rosatom launches new generation radiopharmaceutical plant in Kaluga region - www1.ru
title: Rosatom opens a new-generation radiopharmaceutical plant in Kaluga
blurb: Russia's Rosatom has launched a new-generation radiopharmaceutical production facility in the Kaluga region, adding domestic capacity for medical isotopes.

original_title: Nickel-Catalyzed Regio-Controllable α- or β-Hydroalkylation of α,β-Unsaturated Amides
title: One nickel catalyst, your choice of α or β alkylation
blurb: A Ni-catalyzed cross-electrophile coupling alkylates unsaturated amides with unactivated alkyl bromides, and tuning the catalyst flips the regioselectivity between the α- and β-carbon on the same substrate. Handy if the subtle electronic differences behind that switch hold up across more than the reported cases.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: In Situ Peptide Assembly for Cancer Therapy
title: Skip the pre-made peptide, assemble it after it's inside the tumor
blurb: Tracks the shift in anticancer peptide design from preassembled nanomaterials, which struggle with circulation and getting deep into tumors, toward strategies that deliver small precursors and trigger assembly into the active structure in situ. The bet is better penetration and stability than shipping the finished nanomaterial.

original_title: Dualitybio’s ADC efforts draw Roche in potential $1B deal - BioWorld News
title: Roche circles Dualitybio's ADC pipeline for a potential $1B deal
blurb: Roche is reportedly in talks for a licensing deal worth up to $1B covering Dualitybio's antibody-drug conjugate portfolio, another case of big pharma buying into someone else's ADC pipeline instead of building it in-house.

original_title: Convergent Synthesis of a Bifunctional GPI as a Universal Platform to Access Diverse GPI and GPI-Anchored Protein Probes.
title: One GPI scaffold, branch off whatever probe you need
blurb: A convergent synthesis builds a bifunctional GPI core meant as a common platform, so different GPI and GPI-anchored protein probes can branch off the same intermediate instead of each getting synthesized from scratch.

original_title: Determining the Redox Potential of a Protein Disulfide Bond.
title: How to actually measure a disulfide bond's redox potential
blurb: A methods chapter laying out the protocol for determining the redox potential of a protein disulfide bond, a lab technique writeup rather than a new finding.

original_title: Intramolecular TDDA Approach to the Dihydrobenzopentalene Skeleton of Aromatized Nine-Membered Enediyne Antibiotics
title: A TDDA route to enediyne antibiotics that stalls at the last step
blurb: They built the TDDA precursors toward the nine-membered enediyne antibiotic core, complete with the acetylene-carboxylic acid and enyne handles, via two Pd-catalyzed steps. Heating them to 150°C to trigger the tetradehydro-Diels-Alder cyclization didn't give the expected product. A negative result on a reaction that's supposed to be dependable for these frameworks.

original_title: Drug‐Derived Tetrahydropyrazines for Late‐Stage α ‐ and β ‐Functionalization of Piperazine‐Based Pharmaceuticals
title: Turning piperazine drugs into their own late-stage functionalization handle
blurb: A riboflavin tetraacetate photocatalyst under blue light strips α- and β-C-H bonds off piperazine rings in existing drugs, generating persistent tetrahydropyrazine intermediates that act as branch points for further functionalization. Works across N-alkyl, N-aryl, and N-heteroaryl piperazines under mild conditions, which matters since piperazine shows up in a huge share of marketed drugs and editing it late-stage has been a pain.

original_title: Advancements and challenges in large molecule drug delivery and devices for patient-centric care
title: The still-unsolved problem of getting biologics out of a syringe
blurb: A survey of why large-molecule drugs, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, nucleic acids, remain stuck on IV, subcutaneous, or intramuscular injection: their size, structural complexity, and instability keep undercutting attempts at more patient-friendly delivery. A stocktake of the field's problems, not a new device.

original_title: Labeling of Amine-Modified RNA.
title: A protocol for labeling amine-modified RNA
blurb: A methods chapter on labeling RNA that already carries an amine modification. Bench protocol, not a finding, so that's the whole story.

original_title: Aimed Bio wins Japan phase 1 nod for Boehringer-licensed ADC, speeds global trial - CHOSUNBIZ - Chosunbiz
title: Aimed Bio's Boehringer-licensed ADC clears Japan phase 1
blurb: Aimed Bio got the nod to start a Japan phase 1 on the ADC it licensed from Boehringer, which it's framing as a step toward a faster global trial. Just a green light so far, nothing about data yet.

original_title: Biologic prodrugs: inactive protein and peptide drugs and drug conjugates with targeted activation
title: Biologics that stay inactive until they hit the target
blurb: A review on biologic prodrugs: proteins, peptides, and conjugates built to stay off until something at the target site switches them on. The pitch is fixing biologics' usual weak points, poor tissue penetration, degradation, fast clearance, by keeping the drug inert until it's where it needs to be. Review, not new data.

original_title: Surface chemistry governs sex-dependent responses to PEG and zwitterionic siRNA nanocarriers in primary macrophages
title: PEG's zwitterionic replacement isn't neutral on sex either
blurb: Zwitterionic coatings get pushed as the fix for PEG immunogenicity, but tested head to head with PEG on cationic siRNA nanoparticles in primary macrophages, both polymers produced sex-dependent responses. Nanocarrier work routinely skips sex as a variable, and this is a case where it clearly should matter.

original_title: Mechanistic Insights into Photo-Induced Bond Dissociation of a 2-(4-Nitrophenyl)-1H-indole-3-ylmethyl (NPIM) Derivative: A Case Study on Quantum Spin-Manipulation for Uncaging
title: Chasing the triplet pathway in a photocage's uncaging step
blurb: Follow-up to their spin-manipulation trick for boosting uncaging yield, now digging into whether a triplet excited-state route works for an NPIM photocage with a benzoate leaving group. Mechanism-building, not a new tool yet.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: RNA Labeling of Nucleolar Transcripts by 5-Ethynyl Uridine Click Chemistry.
title: Click-labeling RNA in the nucleolus
blurb: A protocol for tagging nucleolar transcripts with 5-ethynyl uridine and click chemistry. Standard EU-click labeling, just pointed specifically at the nucleolus.

original_title: Accessing P-Chiral Diphosphines through Nickel-Catalyzed Asymmetric Hydrophosphination
title: Nickel catalysis makes P-chiral bisphosphines without the usual grief
blurb: Asymmetric hydrophosphination of phosphine-borane alkynes, nickel-catalyzed, works across a broad range of alkynes and secondary phosphines. The P-stereogenic bisphosphines deprotect in situ into ligands, which they then used to build chiral metal complexes for catalysis. A more direct route to a ligand class that's usually a slog to get enantiopure.

original_title: Nigeria records new cancer treatment milestone with actinium therapy at Loveworld Medical Centre - Business News Nigeria
title: Actinium therapy lands at a Nigerian hospital
blurb: Loveworld Medical Centre says it's now offering actinium-based cancer treatment, calling it a milestone for the country. That's about all the detail on offer, no numbers on patients or outcomes.

original_title: HFIP-Promoted Nenitzescu Indole Synthesis: An Application toward the Synthesis of Umifenovir
title: A metal-free, one-pot route to Umifenovir's indole core
blurb: HFIP pulls double duty as solvent and promoter in a Nenitzescu indole synthesis that skips metals and catalysts entirely, forming the C-C and C-N bonds in one pot from amines and benzoquinones to reach 5-hydroxyindoles including the Umifenovir scaffold. Moderate to high yields and it dodges the multistep sequence that usually eats yield.

original_title: Establishment and Validation of a Stability-Indicating RP-HPLC Protocol for Mavacamten in Oral Capsule Preparations
title: An HPLC method for Mavacamten capsules, since nobody had one
blurb: Mavacamten is approved for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy but had no pharmacopoeial assay, so this validates a stability-indicating RP-HPLC method for the capsules on a C18 column with a TFA/acetonitrile mobile phase. Unglamorous, but the kind of thing a QC lab actually needs.

original_title: Synthetic Strategies of Heterocycle‐Linked Sulfonamide Hybrids as Emerging Anticancer Agents: An Update
title: A five-year roundup of sulfonamide-heterocycle scaffolds against cancer
blurb: A review, not new chemistry: it stitches together the bond-forming strategies and late-stage diversification tricks used over the past five years to build sulfonamide-heterocycle hybrids for anticancer work. Useful as a methods index, not a result of its own.

original_title: Continuous Flow Photochemical Hydroacylation of Dialkyl Azodicarboxylates: Telescoped Synthesis of Moclobemide
title: Flow photochemistry builds moclobemide in one telescoped run
blurb: A continuous-flow photochemical hydroacylation of azodicarboxylates, broad substrate scope and fast, good enough to chain straight into a multistep synthesis of the antidepressant moclobemide without isolating intermediates. 55% overall yield end to end.

original_title: Iridium(III)-Catalyzed C–H Allylation and Aza-Wacker Cyclization of 2-Aryl Quinazolinones and Vinylcyclopropanes
title: Quinazolinones get allylated, then locked into piperidines
blurb: Ir(III) handles the C-H allylation with vinylcyclopropanes, then Pd(II) closes an aza-Wacker cyclization with an olefin migration on top, giving piperidine-fused quinazolinones with full site selectivity across a wide substrate range. They also ran Diels-Alder and Michael additions on the products, so the new handles aren't just decorative.

original_title: Selective separation of Ag(I)/Pd(II) using mesoporous Mn 3 O 4 for 111 Ag production
title: A mesoporous sponge that pulls silver out of palladium for 111Ag production
blurb: CTAB-templated mesoporous Mn3O4, modest surface area and ~4 nm pores, but it grabs Ag+ selectively over Pd2+ in a single step: 132 mg/g in batch, 112 mg/g in a column. Not glamorous, but it's exactly the separations chemistry carrier-free 111Ag supply depends on.

original_title: Harnessing through-space orbital interactions for multicentred organosulfur catalysis
title: Sulfur atoms talking to each other through space, not through bonds
blurb: Instead of the usual move of geometrically distorting a p-block center to tune its frontier orbitals, this spirocyclic scaffold lets sulfur atoms interact through space to push HOMO energies up, then puts that to work driving multicentered organosulfur catalysis.

original_title: [64Cu]CuCl2 as a Novel Metabolic Marker of Progression and Survival in Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer
title: 64Cu-chloride floated as a bladder cancer prognosis tracer
blurb: [64Cu]CuCl2 PET proposed as a marker for tracking disease progression and survival in muscle-invasive bladder cancer. No data to go on beyond the claim itself here.

original_title: Intramolecular Nickel‐Catalyzed Reductive Coupling: Enantioselective Synthesis of Tetrahydroisoquinolines and Related Heterocycles
title: A chiral ligand that finally makes the hard anti-amino-alcohol tetrahydroisoquinolines
blurb: Nickel-catalyzed intramolecular reductive coupling of amino-substituted dienoates with a tethered aldehyde, using the P-chiral ligand AntPhos, delivers hydroxylated tetrahydroisoquinolines with the anti-configured amino alcohol motif that's normally miserable to get enantiopure. Barely any precedent for this route, and they show it's not a dead end by running further functionalization on the products.

original_title: A Minimal Hemin-Albumin Nanozyme with Peroxidase-like Activity Enabling Tyrosine-Crosslinked Hydrogel Formation.
title: Hemin and albumin, nothing else, acting like a peroxidase
blurb: A minimal nanozyme built from just hemin and albumin, with peroxidase-like activity strong enough to drive tyrosine crosslinking and form a hydrogel. A simple recipe for something usually built with a lot more scaffolding.

original_title: ASCENT-04 Exploratory Analysis: Sacituzumab Govitecan Plus Pembrolizumab Improves PFS2, Delays Next Treatment - The ASCO Post
title: Sacituzumab govitecan plus pembrolizumab keeps paying off past first progression
blurb: An exploratory analysis of ASCENT-04: adding sacituzumab govitecan to pembrolizumab improves PFS2 (time to second progression) and delays the next line of treatment. It's a secondary, exploratory readout rather than the trial's primary endpoint, but it argues the combo's benefit holds up over time.

original_title: Synthesis of S ‐Linked Glycoconjugates of Monosaccharides and Levoglucosenone Derivatives Through Photoinduced Thiol–Ene Reaction Mediated by 4CzIPN and Its Water Soluble Analog
title: Thiol-ene chemistry turns levoglucosenone into S-linked sugar mimics
blurb: Photocatalyzed hydrothiolation with 4CzIPN, and a water-soluble version of it, under mild visible light hooks monosaccharide-derived thiols onto levoglucosenone scaffolds like cyrene and aminocyrene, producing a library of S-linked glycomimetics. Renewable feedstock chemistry doing glycoconjugate work without harsh conditions.

original_title: Efficient and Stereoselective Enzymatic Synthesis of Multisubstituted α , β -Diamino Acid
title: An aldolase moonlighting as a Mannich catalyst
blurb: L-threonine aldolases, repurposed to run a stereoselective intermolecular Mannich reaction, turn simple precursors into densely substituted α,β-diamino acids at scale. Mining enzyme sequence diversity got over 50 derivatives out, yields up to 97%, dr and er both past 99%. A motif that's normally miserable to make asymmetrically, done here without a chiral ligand in sight.

original_title: Highly Efficient Iron-Catalyzed Asymmetric Hydrosilylation: Photo-acceleration and Positive Non-linear Effect
title: An iron catalyst that's chiral at the metal, not the ligand
blurb: The chirality comes entirely from a stereogenic iron center, with the ligands themselves achiral, which is a neat trick for an earth-abundant metal running asymmetric hydrosilylation of aryl ketones. Light speeds it up, there's a positive non-linear effect reported, and it turned out more than 50 chiral alcohols at good yield and ee. Iron doing a job usually reserved for precious-metal chiral-at-metal catalysts.

original_title: One catalyst, two geometries: Iridium catalysis enables stereodivergent synthesis of chiral Z- and E-allylated isochromanones
title: One iridium catalyst, both alkene geometries on demand
blurb: Iridium catalysis that reaches either the Z- or E-allylated isochromanone from the same catalyst system, stereodivergent rather than needing a separate setup for each geometry.

original_title: Electrochemical Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer Free Energy Surfaces from Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics
title: Watching proton-coupled electron transfer happen at a Pt/water interface
blurb: A first-principles platform builds free energy surfaces and reorganization energies for interfacial electrochemical PCET, using ab initio molecular dynamics in explicit solvent. Hydrogen electrosorption at Pt(111)/water stands in as the model reaction, treated as a nonadiabatic transition. Puts actual numbers on solvent reorganization that's usually just hand-waved.

original_title: Formosa Pharmaceuticals Files Clinical Trial Application for TSY-110, an Antibody-Drug Conjugate Biosimilar Targeting HER2-Positive Breast Cancers - BioSpace
title: Formosa's HER2 ADC biosimilar clears a CTA filing
blurb: Formosa Pharmaceuticals has filed a clinical trial application for TSY-110, an antibody-drug conjugate biosimilar targeting HER2-positive breast cancer. Just the regulatory step, no trial data yet.

original_title: Synthesis of β ‐ and γ ‐Carbolinones Through a Fe(III)‐Mediated Radical 6‐ Endo ‐Trig Cyclization of Indole‐Based Ugi 4‐CR Adducts
title: Fe(III) radical cyclization turns Ugi adducts into carbolinones
blurb: A Fe(III)-mediated 6-endo-trig radical cyclization of indole-based Ugi four-component adducts builds both β- and γ-carbolinones through an Fe(III)-H intermediate. Mild conditions, atom-efficient, and broad functional group tolerance by the authors' account.

original_title: Synthetic Studies Toward 2- Epi Altemicidin and Its Derivatives: Construction of the 6-Azatetrahydroindane Core
title: Shaving three steps off the road to 2-epi altemicidin
blurb: Working toward 2-epi altemicidin to probe the stereochemistry behind SB-203207, an IleRS inhibitor, the synthesis nails down the 6-azatetrahydroindane core with its awkward nitrogen quaternary stereocenter and trims the known intermediate route by three steps. Groundwork for structure-activity work on a target that matters because IleRS inhibitors are a real drug lead.

original_title: Synthesis of Hydroxamate-Type Siderophores and Their Conjugates with PNA for Evaluation of Iron Binding and Bacterial Uptake.
title: Hydroxamate siderophores wired to PNA for iron-uptake assays
blurb: A methods chapter on making hydroxamate-type siderophores and conjugating them to PNA, set up to test iron binding and how well bacteria take the conjugates up. A protocol, not a result.

original_title: Advances in Bispecific Antibodies and Antibody–Drug Conjugates for Colorectal Cancer Treatment
title: Where bispecifics and ADCs are heading for colorectal cancer
blurb: A review rounding up bispecific antibodies and bispecific antibody-drug conjugates for colorectal cancer, covering T-cell engagers that recruit immune cells to tumors and dual checkpoint inhibitors stacked on top. Pitched as a way around the tumor heterogeneity and resistance that plain monoclonal antibodies run into. Review article, so no new data, just the state of the field.

original_title: Electrochemical Cobalt/Vanadium Relay Catalysis: Enantioselective Markovnikov Hydrooxygenation of Alkenes
title: Cobalt and vanadium splitting the job on alkene hydrooxygenation
blurb: Markovnikov hydrooxygenation of alkenes usually forces you to control regiochemistry and stereochemistry at the same time, so this splits the work across two catalysts: a cobalt hydride does the HAT to generate the Markovnikov radical, then a vanadium catalyst handles the stereodetermining step, all run electrochemically. Relay catalysis turning one hard problem into two easier ones.

original_title: What Does Personalization of Radiopharmaceutical Therapy Require? - cancernetwork.com
title: What would it actually take to personalize radiopharmaceutical therapy
blurb: The framing question for a field that's still mostly dosing radiopharmaceuticals the same way for everyone.

original_title: Access to ( E )-2-(Benzo[1,2]dithiol-3-ylidene)acetonitriles via a Three-Component Reaction of o -Nitro-/Halobenzaldehydes, Cyanoacetates, and Sulfur
title: Elemental sulfur builds dithiole rings out of nitrobenzaldehydes
blurb: A three-component, metal-free reaction combines o-nitro or o-halobenzaldehydes, cyanoacetates, and plain elemental sulfur to build (E)-2-(benzo[1,2]dithiol-3-ylidene)acetonitriles in one pot. Step-economical and mild, and it turns sulfur into an actual reagent instead of a waste byproduct, which is the sustainability pitch here.

original_title: From Cross-Reactivity to Specificity: A SELEX-Derived Aptamer Sensor Array for Aristolochic Acid I and Aristolactam I
title: One aptamer wasn't enough to tell these toxins apart, so they built an array
blurb: Capture-SELEX turned up three DNA aptamers against aristolochic acid I, the nastiest of the nephrotoxic aristolochic acids, each with sub-micromolar affinity. Rather than pick a winner, they wired the cross-reactive set into a sensor array, turning the promiscuity that usually ruins a single-aptamer assay into what actually separates AAI from its close relative aristolactam I.

original_title: ERα Micromap (µMap) proximity labeling reveals fulvestrant mechanisms
title: What fulvestrant is actually doing to ERα, twenty years after approval
blurb: Fulvestrant's been prescribed for ER+ breast cancer since the early 2000s and its mechanism is still murky, with some data showing it works without even degrading ERα. This uses split-intein µMap photo-proximity labeling to map what ERα sits next to when the drug's on board, going after the interactome instead of just the degradation readout everyone's been arguing about.
